card.name: The word retrospective in study descriptions
card.fires_on: The word "retrospective" (or its second part, "pective", after "Retros") when it describes a study design such as cohort study, case-control study, analysis or review in label text.

modes.label: Retrospective before cohort
modes.description: The word "retrospective" after "a" or "population-based" and before "cohort study".
modes.example: In a population-based<< retrospective>> cohort study covering all live births in Denmark

modes.label: Split word Retros-pective
modes.description: The last part "pective" of "Retrospective" at the start of a sentence about case-control studies or analyses.
modes.example: Retros<<pective>> case-control studies in patients of European,
